question.text: An AIF must carry out a yearly audit of the PPM. By when must the audit findings and proposed corrective measures be communicated to stakeholders?

answer.text: Within 6 months from the end of the financial year
Within 3 months from the end of the financial year
Within 30 days from the end of the financial year
Within 1 year from the end of the financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 112 of the workbook, the yearly PPM audit findings along with proposed corrective measures must be communicated to stakeholders within 6 months from the end of the financial year. The Trap: 30 days and 3 months are too short for a full audit cycle; 1 year is inconsistent with the 'yearly' requirement. Note: This communication requirement is part of the AIF's annual compliance cycle for the Private Placement Memorandum.
